macros.name: Expand
macros.doc: Performs a single expansion on the token or group immediately following and places the result directly into the definition without further processing.

macros.name: MultiExpand
macros.doc: Expands the following token or group the given number of times.

macros.name: NoExpand
macros.doc: If a token is preceeded by \NoExpand then it is inserted in the definition exactly as-is.

macros.name: Super
macros.doc: When redefining an already existing macro, \Super will expand to the previous definition of the macro. Any macro parameters are automatically substituted.
